title: Bias-aware LSTM and Transformer text ensemble
summary: Comments are lowercased and regex-tokenized; a vocabulary is fitted only on training text, with padding, unknown tokens, and head truncation to 256 tokens. The system trains three randomly seeded two-layer bidirectional LSTMs and one six-layer pre-layer-normalized Transformer. Both use masked max-and-mean sequence pooling, dense classification heads for toxicity logits, and auxiliary multilabel identity heads. The Transformer is first pretrained on training comments with masked-language modeling over a restricted prediction vocabulary, then fine-tuned. Supervised loss is weighted binary cross-entropy for toxicity plus binary cross-entropy for soft identity targets. Training uses shuffled length buckets, token-budgeted batches, mixed precision, AdamW, gradient clipping, warmup and decay schedules. LSTM predictions blend exponentially weighted epoch checkpoints. Inference sigmoid-transforms logits; predictions are averaged within each family, then the LSTM and Transformer means are blended equally and clipped to [0,1].
